{"description": "As a scrum master, I want to archive completed sprints so that the board list stays focused on active work.

- Archived sprints remain searchable.
- Archiving is reversible within 30 days.", "acceptance_criteria": "- Given a completed sprint, when the scrum master archives it, then it disappears from the active list.
- Given an invalid input, when the action runs, then an error is reported and nothing changes.
- Given a timeout during the action, when it is retried, then no duplicate result appears.", "changed": true, "rationale": "Applied the edge_cases operation: tightened phrasing and kept every fact."}
